videos.description: Israel’s great mistake was not a lack of passion for God, but trying to establish the righteousness God wanted to give. videos.title: The Unqualified
videos.speaker: Pastor Brandon Ball
videos.description:
Great faith is not faith in the greatness of your faith; it is faith in the greatness of Jesus. You were unqualified, but Jesus qualified you by removing every charge and making you righteous. The unqualified receive everything because the Qualified One did everything.

videos.description: Religion keeps adding pulleys: pray more, fast more, give more, and maybe the weight will finally move. videos.title: One and the Same
videos.speaker: Pastor Brandon Ball
videos.description:
The world says count to ten when life presses in; the gospel says count to one. Through the cross Jesus joined Himself to you, and you are now one spirit with Him. Your sufficiency is not something you produce under pressure — it is Someone who lives inside you.
